name: Eri Aster
seed: To captain a cargo craft without compromising her load rules.
design: Warm brown fruit bat, plum wing membranes, cream flight tunic, ochre sash and brass weight tokens.
history: A sailmaker’s daughter who survived a captain’s overloaded departure as a young crew member and became a dock rigger.
desire: To captain a cargo craft without compromising her load rules.
contradiction: Overprepares until a safe opportunity passes.
relationships: Serik offers shortcuts; Vessa could become a guide; Gorilla respects her refusal of a heroic overload.
arc: Makes a bounded launch with incomplete weather knowledge and turns back when conditions change, even before an audience.
story_engine: A comic cargo manifest hides a living garden; two islands require rescue but one craft cannot take everyone at once.
writer_truth: She once signed a load count under pressure; the survivor story is also a confession.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
